intro: Libya is divided between rival authorities in the west and east, with UN efforts to unite them.

chapters.title: Two governments
text: A UN-recognised government sits in Tripoli. In the east, a rival government is backed by the forces of Khalifa Haftar. Many armed groups control local areas.

chapters.title: Elections
text: National elections planned for 2021 were postponed and have not been held.

keyTerms.meaning: An armed group that is not a regular army.
